================================================================================
CREATE JSON RELATIONAL DUALITY VIEW
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE JSON RELATIONAL DUALITY VIEW dept_dv AS
  SELECT JSON {'_id' : d.deptno,
               'name' : d.dname WITH NOUPDATE,
               'emps' : (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON {'id' : e.empno, 'name' : e.ename})
                           FROM emp e WITH INSERT UPDATE
                           WHERE e.deptno = d.deptno)}
  FROM dept d WITH INSERT UPDATE DELETE;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW sales_mv
  BUILD IMMEDIATE REFRESH FAST ON COMMIT ENABLE QUERY REWRITE
  AS SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY region;

CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE person_t FORCE AUTHID DEFINER AS OBJECT (
  id NUMBER,
  name VARCHAR2(50),
  CONSTRUCTOR FUNCTION person_t (SELF IN OUT NOCOPY person_t, name VARCHAR2) RETURN SELF AS RESULT,
  MEMBER FUNCTION get_name RETURN VARCHAR2 DETERMINISTIC,
  MEMBER PROCEDURE set_name (p_name IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'x'),
  STATIC FUNCTION make (p_id NUMBER := 1) RETURN person_t,
  MAP MEMBER FUNCTION sort_key RETURN NUMBER
) NOT FINAL;

================================================================================
CREATE DOMAIN
================================================================================

CREATE DOMAIN IF NOT EXISTS email_d AS VARCHAR2(100) CONSTRAINT email_ck CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(email_d, '^.+@.+$')) DISPLAY LOWER(email_d) ORDER UPPER(email_d) ANNOTATIONS (title 'Email');
CREATE DOMAIN year_d AS NUMBER(4) STRICT DEFAULT ON NULL 2000 NOT NULL;
CREATE DOMAIN status_d AS ENUM (active = 'A', inactive = 'I', unknown);
CREATE DOMAIN addr_d AS (street AS VARCHAR2(40), city AS VARCHAR2(20)) CONSTRAINT addr_ck CHECK (city IS NOT NULL);
CREATE FLEXIBLE DOMAIN temp_d (val, unit) CHOOSE DOMAIN USING (u VARCHAR2(1)) FROM (CASE u WHEN 'C' THEN celsius_d(val, unit) ELSE fahrenheit_d(val, unit) END);

---

================================================================================
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH
================================================================================

CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH IF NOT EXISTS bank_graph
  VERTEX TABLES (
    accounts KEY (id) LABEL account PROPERTIES (id, name AS owner),
    persons AS p PROPERTIES ARE ALL COLUMNS EXCEPT (secret)
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    transfers KEY (txn_id)
      SOURCE KEY (src) REFERENCES accounts (id)
      DESTINATION KEY (dst) REFERENCES accounts (id)
      LABEL transfer NO PROPERTIES
  );

---

(source_file

      (identifier))

================================================================================
ALTER statements of other objects
================================================================================

ALTER INDEX emp_name_ix REBUILD ONLINE TABLESPACE users;
ALTER INDEX emp_name_ix RENAME TO emp_name_ix2;
ALTER SEQUENCE emp_seq INCREMENT BY 10 MAXVALUE 100;
ALTER USER app IDENTIFIED BY "new" QUOTA UNLIMITED ON users ACCOUNT LOCK;
ALTER USER app GRANT CONNECT THROUGH proxy_user;
ALTER VIEW emp_v COMPILE;
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW sales_mv REFRESH COMPLETE;
ALTER TRIGGER emp_trg DISABLE;
ALTER PROCEDURE p COMPILE REUSE SETTINGS;
ALTER TYPE person_t ADD ATTRIBUTE (email VARCHAR2(50)) CASCADE;

================================================================================
DROP statements
================================================================================

DROP TABLE hr.employees CASCADE CONSTRAINTS PURGE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t;
DROP INDEX emp_name_ix ONLINE FORCE;
DROP VIEW emp_v;
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW sales_mv PRESERVE TABLE;
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG ON sales;
DROP SEQUENCE emp_seq;
DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM emp FORCE;
DROP USER app CASCADE;
DROP TABLESPACE data_ts INCLUDING CONTENTS AND DATAFILES CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TYPE person_t FORCE;
DROP TYPE BODY person_t;
DROP PACKAGE BODY app_pkg;
DROP PROCEDURE p;
DROP PUBLIC DATABASE LINK remote.example.com;
DROP DOMAIN email_d FORCE PRESERVE;
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH bank_graph;
DROP PLUGGABLE DATABASE pdb2 INCLUDING DATAFILES;
DROP DATABASE;

================================================================================
ASSOCIATE and DISASSOCIATE STATISTICS
================================================================================

ASSOCIATE STATISTICS WITH COLUMNS hr.employees.salary, employees.bonus USING stats_t DEFAULT COST (100, 5, 0);
ASSOCIATE STATISTICS WITH FUNCTIONS f1, hr.f2 DEFAULT SELECTIVITY 10;
ASSOCIATE STATISTICS WITH INDEXTYPES ctxsys.context USING NULL WITH SYSTEM MANAGED STORAGE TABLES;
DISASSOCIATE STATISTICS FROM PACKAGES app_pkg FORCE;

---

CREATE INDEX with quoted names and FILTER BY
================================================================================

CREATE INDEX "CTX"."IX" ON "CTX"."DOCS" ("TEXT") INDEXTYPE IS "CTXSYS"."CONTEXT" FILTER BY model, price PARAMETERS ('sync (every "sysdate+1")');

================================================================================
CREATE VIEW of an object type
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW oc_customers OF customer_typ WITH OBJECT OID (customer_id) AS SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW db_summary OF XMLType WITH OBJECT ID ('DB_SUMMARY') AS SELECT 1 FROM dual;

CREATE TYPE cat_list AS TABLE OF REF category_typ;

================================================================================
CREATE JSON DUALITY VIEW with an array in brackets
================================================================================

CREATE JSON DUALITY VIEW team_dv AS
  SELECT JSON {'_id' : t.team_id, 'players' : [SELECT JSON {'id' : p.player_id} FROM player p WITH INSERT WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id]}
  FROM team t WITH INSERT UPDATE DELETE;

---
